n    base = await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD')
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='chupa-serve-premise-') as directory:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        captured = []
        def observe(frame, event, value):
            if event == 'return' and frame.f_code is triage.triage_pass.__code__:
                if 'driver' in frame.f_locals:
                    captured.append(frame.f_locals['driver'])
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        sys.setprofile(observe)
        try:
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)
        assert len(captured) == 1
        driver = captured[0]
        evidence = {
            'base_commit': base,
            'driver_shares_checkout_journal': driver.journal is rig.checkout.journal,
            'effects_share_checkout_journal': driver.effects._journal is rig.checkout.journal,
            'same_journal_directory': driver.journal.dir == rig.checkout.journal.dir,
            'model_calls': len(llm.requests),
            'process_calls': len(rig.exec.calls),
            'writer_substitution': False,
        }
        print(json.dumps(evidence))
        assert not evidence['driver_shares_checkout_journal']
        assert not evidence['effects_share_checkout_journal']
        assert evidence['same_journal_directory']
        assert evidence['model_calls'] == evidence['process_calls'] == 0
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD') == base
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    print('Final HEAD unchanged; worktree clean')
